nodes.question: How can teenagers be encouraged to adopt sustainable cleanliness practices?
nodes.answer: Teenagers can be encouraged to adopt sustainable cleanliness practices by promoting the use of eco-friendly cleaning products and reducing water and energy consumption while cleaning.
